components.name: Competitor Number Card
components.description: The bib a dancer wears: bold tabular number on white paper, a band in the dancer's colour, two flat safety pins. 88px leads a dancer's day; 176px (number-card-xl) leads a competition dancer's page; 44px plain tiles in lists.

narrative.overview: The best seat at a Highland dance competition is at the edge of the platform. The app is that seat: everything a family needs at a glance, native and calm, with colour that carries news.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper on mist; glass only for chrome
Continuous corners; capsules for buttons and chips

rules.name: The Colour Is News Rule
rules.body: Pink, amber and green appear only when they report live, next (Manage only) or done. Families' screens never guess what's on next. Done or out is muted by colour and words, never opacity.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Saltire Blue fills at most one button per view.

rules.name: The Title First Rule
rules.body: A page leads with its title; date, place or category follow underneath. Nothing above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Only the brand panel gets texture and gradient light.

notes: Scott, the logo dancer, appears whole and sparingly: About hero and nothing-yet empty states, never on competition-day screens.

The Number Card: on competition-day screens a followed dancer is the bib they wear (88px on Home and Overview, 176px on their competition page), placings pinned beside it as 48px rosettes; dancer colour lives only on the bib's band.
